purpose.zh: 练核心稳定和肩部支撑
purpose.en: Build core stability and shoulder support.

text.zh: 收紧腹部，双膝离地几厘米
text.en: Brace your abs and float your knees a few centimetres off the floor

text.zh: 四足跪撑，手在肩下，膝在髋下，脚尖踩地
text.en: On hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips, toes tucked.

text.zh: 背部平直，髋不抬高，再轻轻放下
text.en: Keep your back flat and hips level, then set your knees down softly.

cautions.zh: 先做2–3分钟手腕热身；腕部刺痛或麻木立即停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists for 2–3 minutes first; stop right away if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
